SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Block ads and trackers
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Blocks requests to hosts on a downloaded block list. The list is fetched once when you turn this on, then only when you update it.

EditTextPreference.android:title: Block list address
EditTextPreference.android:summary: A hosts-format file. Default: StevenBlack unified hosts (MIT licence).

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Send Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Adds the DNT and Sec-GPC headers to pages you open. Sites may ignore them.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Safe Browsing
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Android's built-in check against known phishing and malware sites, done by the system browser engine.
